description: Risk ledger from 0021. Reproduced/source-reviewed/potential are distinct evidence kinds; monitoring is not a resolved incident.

risks.trigger: probe validator accepted observed:{}
risks.stopScope: strict/adapted gate promotion from probe evidence
risks.mitigation: required per-candidate observations and coverage recomputation
risks.residualRisk: macOS producer/validator parity must be rechecked on the integrated candidate.

risks.trigger: DOM clipboard write/copy outside OS paste opt-in
risks.mitigation: default DOM clipboard probe is read-only; full probe is opt-in
risks.residualRisk: opt-in path must be exercised in a disposable environment.

risks.trigger: NSNull subscripted as dictionary in native probe
risks.mitigation: typed accessors, required-observation checks and terminal catch
risks.residualRisk: native timeout/exception injection is not yet covered by an automated lane.

risks.trigger: saved baseline admitted without completion/pins/shape
risks.mitigation: compiled validate_baseline before candidate launch; non-empty trace/measurement
risks.residualRisk: real Electron oracle baseline remains NOT RUN locally.

risks.trigger: IPC and native PR stacks are unmerged and based on older main
risks.mitigation: ordered integration, exact SHA ledger, same-SHA regression
risks.residualRisk: unresolved outdated threads and semantic conflicts may remain.

risks.trigger: QuickJS source checksum and native runtime are unimplemented
risks.mitigation: vendor lock, C ABI ownership tests, jobs/roots, Node-free audit
risks.residualRisk: engine selection alone is not a runtime result.

risks.trigger: child/remote frame, stale generation, forged body or authorized relay confused with direct sender
risks.mitigation: native sender ADR, actual frame/document checks, negative fixtures
risks.residualRisk: not yet reproduced against the production ingress.

risks.trigger: read-only grant used for write, saveAs resave or replaced path
risks.mitigation: rights separation, broker handle validation, commit-point tests

risks.trigger: mutable app root, symlink race or Moji userData reuse
risks.mitigation: immutable staging, disposable OS user, explicit data root
risks.residualRisk: real app execution not yet performed.

risks.trigger: main/native synchronous wait or first-RPC/load cycle
risks.mitigation: sync call classification, deadlines, ingress/load separation

risks.trigger: stale roots/tickets after close, reload or crash
risks.mitigation: owner ledger, revalidation, queue limits, process cleanup

risks.trigger: Moji eager updater/zlib/Buffer or jmd privileged scheme blocks boot
risks.mitigation: pinned build inventory, explicit adaptation, no empty stub

risks.trigger: QuickJS/Node/module/locale/scheduler differences
risks.mitigation: symbol allowlist and oracle traces

risks.trigger: headless CI or synthetic input mistaken for IME/AX/hardware acceptance
risks.mitigation: separate interactive lane and real-machine records

risks.trigger: OS/WebKit update changes public behavior
risks.mitigation: OS/WebView matrix and revalidation

risks.trigger: MoonBit versioned object expiry or checksum drift
risks.mitigation: pinned toolchain checksums and deliberate re-pin

risks.trigger: hidden Node/Electron/CEF, test SPI or secret in artifact
risks.mitigation: static and process/link/spawn audits

risks.trigger: update interruption, wrong signature or non-reversible data migration
risks.mitigation: signed full bundle, backup/restore, commit-point tests

risks.trigger: root license, notices, signing owner or security contact unresolved
risks.mitigation: governance ledger and release gate

risks.trigger: empty-window or partial-process performance claim
risks.mitigation: fixed workload, all processes, raw samples

risks.trigger: strict bridge, another engine/app/OS added to the critical path
risks.mitigation: phase dependencies and explicit scope changes
risks.residualRisk: scope can expand without an ADR.
